_note: Machine-readable completion state. Written by hand from verified evidence, not from intent. A requirement is only VERIFIED when something was actually run and observed; where the only evidence is 'the code exists', the status is IMPLEMENTED. BLOCKED_EXTERNAL means the remaining step is one only the platform owner can take.
production_note: All four Render services auto-deploy from `main`. This branch is NOT merged, so nothing below marked IMPLEMENTED or VERIFIED is live yet. Production currently runs commit 1e6549e.

payments._evidence: 36 live checks in server/scripts/verify-uropay.ts: forged webhook credits nothing, replayed webhook + client poll + 3 concurrent settlements produce exactly one ledger credit and one prize reservation. Provider HTTP stubbed at the fetch boundary; no request has ever reached api.uropay.me.

campaigns._evidence: 60 live checks in server/scripts/verify-campaigns.ts including an independent recount agreeing with the public tally, and tallies restored to their real values on cleanup. Artwork is browser-generated CSS+SVG (PollArtwork.jsx), not art-directed raster campaign key art.

api_and_security._evidence: server/test/registry.test.ts (7), server/test/headers.test.ts (8). CORS verified against live production: an evil Origin receives no allow-origin header. IDOR/role-escalation are covered at specific points (uropayCreateOrder 403, creatorTrackRecord 403, pollAdminList 403) but there is no systematic sweep across every endpoint.

seo._evidence: Verified in a real browser across 7 routes: public pages emit index/follow with correct canonical and title; /dashboard, /login and /contest/*/fund emit noindex,nofollow. sitemap.xml generated with 69 URLs including 60 real contest pages pulled from the live API. og.png is a real 1200x630 asset. None of this is live until the branch is merged.

branding._evidence: 14 usages across the app all resolve to src/components/Brand.jsx. Mark confirmed rendering as SVG with per-instance gradient ids. NOTE: Brand.jsx was byte-identical on main, so the logo seen in production is what the code produces - it was never a stale-asset problem.

mobile_and_accessibility._evidence: Measured in a real browser at 360px and 375px across 11 public routes: 0 horizontal scroll, 0 block-level touch targets under 44px. Inline links inside sentences are deliberately exempt (WCAG 2.5.8). Authenticated routes were NOT measured - they need a session.

infrastructure._evidence: All four Render services return 200. R2 has buckets razekit-production and admin. ADMIN_DATABASE_URL is unset so 4 split-db checks fail environmentally. Resend domain razekit.com is in FAILED status with all four DNS records failing - no transactional email is being delivered.
